I run a wholesale bakery. Hotels and cafes order from me, and I send them invoices. They pay later.
My spreadsheet assumes everyone pays on the due date. So it says I'm fine. But Aldervane Hotels, which is one of my clients, pays about six weeks late.
In week six, my staff bonus, payroll and insurance all come due: one hundred and eighty-nine thousand dollars. The hotel's money won't have arrived. The spreadsheet thinks it has.
So I use Cash Gap Forecaster. It reads three years of my invoices and payments, and learns how each client really pays.
It draws the next thirteen weeks. There's the gap: ten thousand dollars under my minimum, and over a month away.
I try a fix. Move the staff bonus back two weeks,
and week six goes from nineteen thousand dollars to over a hundred thousand.
I saw it over a month early, so I have time to fix it. I'm in control of my cash, and there's no need to stress.
